module: Career tutorial step 6 ("dragStripBasics"): learning a drag race. The player lines up (staging), waits for the countdown, launches, reaches the finish line, then a timeslip popup concludes the step. Also handles disqualifications (false start or leaving the lane), coaching popups that pause the game (simTimeAuthority) and a slow motion at the end of the countdown. The hooks dragRaceStarted, dragRaceEndLineReached, onDragRacersSetup and onRacerPhaseTransition are emitted by gameplay_drag_*.
notes: Internal phases: waitIntroPopup, active, waitDqPopup, waitFalseStartRestage, waitTimeslipPopup.
After 3 failures since the last reset, the coaching popups (approach, countdown) are allowed again.
A false start disqualification leads to a "return to staging" objective; leaving the lane causes a reset with fade onto the dragStripResetSpot spot then a restart of the attempt (2.5 s wait).
The race hooks only count if the current step is 06dragStripBasics, if the vehicle is the tutorial one and if the player is within the bounds.
End-of-countdown slow motion: simulation time goes from 0.1 to 0.75 over 2 s (quadratic curve), then returns to 1.

setup.desc: Called on activation: resets the state, activates the drivingToDragBounds and dragStripBounds zones, finds the beforeDragStrip and dragStartLine spots, displays the v2/dragStripWelcome welcome popup, switches the prefabs and creates the direction markers (dragGuide1 to 3).

onCareerTutorialLeftBounds.desc: Out-of-bounds hook: starts the step's out-of-bounds reset.

onIntroPopupCareerClosed.desc: Popup close hook: advances the state machine (welcome done -> displays the objectives; disqualification popup -> reset or return to staging; timeslip -> advances to the next step; coaching -> resumes from pause and possible slow motion).

onRacerPhaseTransition.desc: gameplay_drag hook: at the countdown phase, validates the "line up" objective and opens the countdown coaching popup (once).

dragRaceStarted.desc: Hook emitted at the actual start of the race: validates the "line up" and "launch" objectives.

dragRaceEndLineReached.desc: Hook emitted when the vehicle reaches the finish: starts the disqualification flow if the driver is disqualified, otherwise validates the finish objective and opens the timeslip popup after 2 s.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: handles the start slow motion, triggers the approach popup within 15 m of the start line, hides the line marker within 5 m, and detects disqualifications.

onDragRacersSetup.desc: Hook emitted when the racers are put back in place for a new attempt: validates the "return to staging" objective after a false start and restarts the attempt after 1 s.

cleanup.desc: Removes the zone reset, lifts the pause, resets simulation time to 1 and deletes markers, guidance and tasks.

onDebugMenu.desc: Displays the phase and the objectives state; "Skip Step 6" button (marks everything as done and advances).
